answer: Each agent must escrow stake that is slashed when a randomly audited task fails, while rewards vest only after independent agents reproduce its result. A newcomer cannot earn trust by minting identities: each one needs funded stake, and copied work risks correlated failures that burn every linked deposit. During a saffron harvest, a tide of fake buyers might flood a river market, but multiplying accounts only multiplies the capital at risk; the attacker must lock real funds and can lose them.
